Build like a founder. Ship like Spartan.
Our customers are scaling fast - and so are we. That’s why we’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our world-class team.
At Spartan, we don’t act like vendors. We embed with startups backed by YC, Pear VC, BlingCap ,a16z, Techstars, and more — partnering with founders and engineers from Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, Uber, and beyond. Together, we help launch MVPs in 30 days and scale systems that power billions of requests.
This isn’t “just another software engineer role.” It’s a chance to work shoulder-to-shoulder with elite builders, solve complex startup challenges, and see your code directly drive companies raising millions on the global stage.
You’ll also be working at the frontier of AI: 70% of our portfolio today is LLM-powered. Our engineers leverage the latest tools like Cursor, Claude, and Codex to move faster, write cleaner code, and solve harder problems.What You’ll Do
Contribute to real production projects for US-based startups.
Learn and build in one or more areas:
Backend (APIs, databases, cloud infra, distributed systems)
Frontend (React, TypeScript, Next.js, UI/UX)
AI/LLM (RAG pipelines, vector DBs, evals, guardrails)
DevOps/Infra (CI/CD, Kubernetes, observability)
Ship features end-to-end with mentorship from senior Spartan engineers.
Participate in our proven process: async standups, PRDs/RFCs, code reviews, testing.
Experiment with AI-native tooling (Cursor, Claude, Codex) to boost your workflow.
